title: Minswap Cardano DeFi Onboarding: Incentive Program

ms.promise:
Documentation detailing the incentive program point system including: 
・how to qualify for rewards
・what types of actions are required to gain points
・how we plan to balance the point distribution
・how much time the incentive program will last
・how points will be calculated and distributed
・how much rewards are going to be disbursed during this program
・how we plan to track and manage bot and excessive activity

Contextual Notes: Apart from the fixes, there are some changes being made with this last submission of SoM. 
Mainly: it is about the removal of certain actions to qualify for points during the incentive program.
The inclusion of such actions such as providing liquidity or bridging would make the program overly complicated for the development side as well as participation. It would also dilute the low rewards to the point it may make participating in the program not even worth it. For the Wanchain part, we plan on still including the incentives from Wanchain, but it will be handled by Wanchain and not part of this program.
We want this program to be an initiative that is replicable and useful in the future, and can be applied to other projects. For the Cardano ecosystem, the
ms.criteria:
The Point System documentation illustrates in detail:
・how to qualify for rewards during the incentive program:
・which action a user can do to gain points, 
・how points are calculated and distributed, 
・how the points distribution is balanced, 
・how much time the program will last, 
・how much rewards are going to be disbursed
・how we plan to track and manage bot and excessive activity
ms.report: ・A public Google Drive containing Minswap incentive program Point System detailed document containing all of the points mentioned in acceptance criteria

ms.promise:
Output 1:
Development of a functional Points System tracking mechanism on minswap: tracks how many swaps an incentive program user does, total volume of his swaps. The point system keeps track of all this data for every participant. Rewards will be distributed at the end of the program based on this stored data and on how much rewards are to be disbursed. 
Output 2: 
Development of a point dashboard on which participants will be able to see their stats live (traded volume, trades number, personal score) and also top program scorers stats.
Output 3:
Development of an anti bot system with the aim of tracking excessive activity and maintaining points distribution fair.
Output 4:
The point system program will work fetching Minswap DEX database to track users actions. The development of the tracking system, the dashboard and the anti bot system require sql, html, css and typescript coding. 
Contextual Notes:
Please see them in the M1 output section for full rationale.
